name: Shin Youjuu Kyoushitsu: Ecstasy Adventure
original_name: 真・妖獣教室 エクスタシーアドベンチャー
source:
The Earth is under assault by aliens called beasts. They choose this green land as their breeding grounds. But in the Universe there is also an organization that opposes these beasts, and its agents are instantly sent to the Earth. A new round of confrontation starts now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
地球正遭受被称为野兽的外星人的攻击。它们选择这片绿地作为它们的繁殖地。但宇宙中也有一个组织反对这些野兽，它的特工立即被派往地球。新一轮的对抗现在开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
